newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down on selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down on selling pressure.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down in selling pressure triggered primarily by a statement from the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) that cautioned investors against trading in companies which were in the red, brokers said.

"Although a market correction was due after share prices sky-rocketed in euphoric trading by retail investors, the SEC's warning made it (fall) inevitable. Profit-taking may continue tomorrow," said one broker.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange index fell 19.75 points or 0.94 percent at 2067.63 on turnover of 254 million taka. Of 110 issues traded, 63 ended down, 42 closed up and five unchanged.
National Tubes fell 51.90 taka to 1920, Bangladesh Tobacco lost 13.96 to 310.99 and Reckitt & Colman rose 25.34 to 380.57.
